tooltip_bombardment: Capture 8 tiny tiles at once with a bombardment.
tooltip_soldier_spell: Bring 15 extra soldiers to one of your tiles.

tutorial_step_map: This is Africa as seen from space: the Sahara desert, the Congo rain forest, the savanna. The continent is made of hundreds of small squares; the terrain does not change the game. You are the blue squares in the north-west, the bots start at the other ends of Africa. Pinch to zoom and drag to move.
tutorial_step_territory: Select one of your squares, then tap a square next to it to attack or move soldiers. Tap your selected square again to deploy reserve soldiers.
tutorial_step_resources: At the end of each turn you earn 80 diamonds and an extra soldier for every 12 squares you own. Capture a diamond mine for 250 more diamonds, or a gold mine (the gold bars) for 150.
tutorial_step_abilities: Cards are kept in your hand with a count; using one uses it up. Fire Bomb takes 2, Bombardment 8, Super Blast 25 tiles. Atom Bomb takes 25 and Nuclear Bomb 40 tiles anywhere on the map. Tribute takes 200 diamonds from a player. Soldier Spell brings soldiers. Every turn Draw Card gives you a free card; the arrow opens and closes the card panel.
tutorial_step_shop: Buy cards with your diamonds in the Weapon Shop; each one is added to your hand.
tutorial_step_end_turn: When you are ready, press End Turn; the bots play next.
tutorial_step_victory: Wipe every bot off the map, or conquer all of Africa, to win.
hint_select_territory: Tap a square on the map to view its info.
